advice.Cramps: Apply a warm compress to your lower abdomen. Gentle yoga poses like child's pose may help relieve cramping.
advice.Back pain: Try lower back stretches and maintain good posture. A warm bath can help ease muscle tension.
advice.Headache: Stay hydrated and rest in a dark, quiet room. Avoid screen time if possible.
advice.Nausea: Sip ginger tea or eat small, bland meals. Avoid strong smells and greasy foods.
advice.Fatigue: Prioritize 7-9 hours of sleep. Short 20-minute naps can help restore energy without disrupting nighttime sleep.
advice.Bloating: Reduce sodium intake and eat potassium-rich foods like bananas. Gentle walking aids digestion.
advice.Breast tenderness: Wear a supportive bra and reduce caffeine intake. Evening primrose oil may help.
advice.Mood swings: Practice mindfulness or deep breathing. Regular exercise releases endorphins that stabilize mood.
advice.Anxiety: Try box breathing (4-4-4-4) and limit caffeine. Journaling can help process anxious thoughts.
advice.Dizziness: Stand up slowly, stay hydrated, and ensure you're eating regularly. Check your iron levels.
advice.Insomnia: Establish a consistent bedtime routine. Avoid screens 1 hour before bed. Try chamomile tea.
advice.Acne: Keep a gentle skincare routine. Avoid touching your face and consider zinc-rich foods.
advice.Food cravings: Eat balanced meals with protein and fiber to stabilize blood sugar. Dark chocolate (70%+) can satisfy sweet cravings healthily.
advice.default: Monitor this symptom and consult a healthcare provider if it persists.
